behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert quoted semicolon/equal/escaped quote or backslash and empty value.
Assert legacy tokens, case normalization/duplicate override and malformed quote rejection.
docDelivery: Document exact token/quoted grammar, ASCII limits and escape rules.
Explain normalization versus preserved values, last duplicate wins and strict rejection.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Explicit ASCII media-type/token/quoted parameter grammar <=10000 units; lowercase names, last duplicate wins, no extra MIME interpretation.
independence: Extend media-type consumer to quoted parameter values and escaped separators while retaining token-only parsing.
